_comment: Everything specific to dotindot lives here. Edit, then run deploy/deploy.sh on the server (or `node build.mjs` to try it locally).
name: Dotindot Creative

receipts._comment: Things this website can prove about itself. lighthouse is filled after a real Lighthouse run; leave empty to hide.

proof._comment: Real numbers only. Leave a value empty to hide it.

_clients: Real clients only, shown on the home and Clients pages. logo: optional path to an SVG/PNG in assets/clients/ (e.g. "assets/clients/avn-solar.svg"); without one the name is set in type.
_testimonials: Real quotes only, with the client's permission. Each: {"quote": "...", "name": "...", "role": "...", "company": "..."}. Empty = the block is hidden.
_caseStudies: Each: {"client": "...", "title": "...", "result": "e.g. Cost per lead down 38%", "summary": "..."}. Empty = hidden.
_team: Leadership shown on the home and About pages. photo: optional path in assets/team/ (square JPG/PNG); without one, initials are shown.

verify._comment: Paste the content= values from Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools (HTML tag method).

_pageSpeedApiKey: Optional. A free Google Cloud API key (PageSpeed Insights API) gives the speed test a higher daily quota. Works without one.
